messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the person's action in the source video to match the action demonstrated in the motion reference. Transfer only the demonstrated action; do not adopt the reference person's appearance, the reference scene, or the reference camera setup. Preserve all other aspects of the current video, including the person's identity, appearance, scene, lighting, and camera framing.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Please use video 0 as the starting point and apply the following edit to it: Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please change the person's action to match the reference video. Transfer only the demonstrated action, not the reference person's appearance or the reference scene and camera setup. Preserve all other aspects of the current video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The man stands mostly still, shifting his weight slightly and turning his head to look up and to his left near the end of the clip.","camera":"The camera is at eye level in a medium shot, slowly dollying backward to reveal more of the surroundings.","clothing":"He wears a white sleeveless tank top with a large pink and black graphic of palm trees and the words \"Los Angeles\" on the front, along with light blue jeans.","hair_color":"His hair is dark brown or black.","hairstyle":"He has short, dark hair styled upward in a small quiff or fade.","identity":"A young Black man with a slim, athletic build and a short beard stands facing the camera.","scene":"The setting is a futuristic, open-air plaza with a glossy, reflective floor and a large glass-walled structure behind him featuring a glowing teal circular light display."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The man's action changed from the source's more active movement, including a head turn and arm/shoulder motion, to a mostly stationary stance with slight weight shifting and a final upward head turn, matching the reference's general motion. His identity, white Los Angeles tank top, hair, and futuristic plaza setting were preserved. The camera now appears to dolly backward, revealing more of the surrounding buildings, whereas the source framing remained relatively fixed.
arguments.requested_change: Change the person's action to match the motion reference, transferring only the demonstrated action while preserving the original person's identity, appearance, scene, lighting, and camera framing.
uncertain: Whether the subtle body motion in the output closely matches the reference motion beyond the final head turn.
unexpected_changes: Camera framing changed from a relatively fixed medium shot to a backward dolly that reveals more of the background environment.
